_help: The books shown in the home page slider, in this order. To swap a book, change its id (the number at the start of the book's web address, e.g. /books/137-... is id 137) and rebuild. Each book needs an author, a cover and a description in data/descriptions.json (run: node scripts/fetch_descriptions.mjs). The 'why' notes are just for people reading this file.

books.why: Biography - George Jordac on Imam Ali's justice (kept)
Governance - Muhammad Baqir as-Sadr on which social system suits humanity
History - Allama Rizvi's full account of the Prophet's life (kept)
Fiqh - Secrets of the Hajj: the inner meaning of each act of Hajj
Philosophy - Mutahhari on the Islamic approach to society and history (kept author; his Unschooled Prophet has no real description)
